paper_title: APT Improving Specialist LLM Performance with Weakness Case Acquisition   and Iterative Preference Training
caption: The exploration of hyperparameters.
model_annotation: This line plot, titled "The exploration of hyperparameters," illustrates the relationship between a variable labeled "N" on the x-axis and "Performance" on the y-axis, for a model or method named "Dolly" as indicated in the legend. The x-axis, labeled "N," is on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with major tick marks at integer values (0, 2, 4). The y-axis, labeled "Performance," is also on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 22.75 to 23.75, with labeled tick marks at 22.75, 23.00, 23.25, 23.50, and 23.75. A single teal line with circular markers connects four data points: at N=0, Performance is approximately 22.75; at N=1, Performance peaks at approximately 23.75; at N=2, Performance drops to approximately 23.25; and at N=4, Performance further declines to approximately 22.75. The line shows a sharp initial increase followed by a steady, linear decrease across the remaining range of N.
